prompt_text: What is the best tanning salon in Charlotte NC?
answer_verbatim:
Do you mean a UV-bed salon or a spray (sunless) tanning salon — and what part of Charlotte are you in (ZIP or neighborhood)? I can look up current top-rated places near you and give names, addresses, prices and review summaries.

If you want an immediate answer without a lookup, here’s how to pick the “best” salon and what to look for:

- Decide spray vs. UV: spray (sunless) is much safer for skin health; UV booths increase cancer/aging risk.  
- Read recent Google and Yelp reviews (look for consistency over time).  
- Check before/after photos and social media to judge color and technician skill.  
- Ask about products and solution types (organic, DHA concentration, custom blending).  
- Ask whether technicians are certified, do a patch test and give prep/aftercare instructions.  
- Inspect cleanliness, ventilation and whether they provide disposable undergarments/eye protection.  
- Compare pricing and packages (single session vs. memberships/loyalty deals).  
- If choosing UV, ask bed types (high-pressure vs. high-intensity), maintenance schedule, session timing and skin-type guidance.

If you want, tell me which neighborhood or ZIP code and whether you prefer spray or UV, and I’ll find the top-rated options in Charlotte and summarize them.
